items.title: Labarbera interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2021
items.q: if this Trump guy had had another four years Marie and I would be out of the country.

ctx.x: Well I’ll wrap up with a basic non-music question. How are you feeling about the state of our country?

Well it’s a little bit better. I mean I see things in a positive light now. Quite honestly, and I’ll be political, if this Trump guy had had another four years Marie and I would be out of the country. We would be gone. I mean honestly, I would be probably back in Italy. I don’t know. But that was really strong on my mind because I don’t think I could have seen the country deteriorate like that and live in it.
Okay. Anything that you’d like to add that I haven’t asked about?
